package statistic_test

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	statistichttp "github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/infrastructure/http/statistic"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
)

func TestClientGetsBoundedLearningSessionSummary(t *testing.T) {
	studentID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"
	sessionID := "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		require.Equal(t, http.MethodGet, r.Method)
		require.Equal(t, "/internal/v1/students/"+studentID+"/learning-sessions/"+sessionID+"/summary", r.URL.Path)
		require.Equal(t, "internal-token", r.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"summary":{
			"analytics_session_id":"` + sessionID + `","student_id":"` + studentID + `",
			"started_at":"2026-08-31T10:00:00Z","last_activity_at":"2026-08-31T10:30:00Z",
			"wall_clock_seconds":1800,"active_learning_seconds":1200,"lesson_count":1,
			"task_count":2,"question_count":3,"selected_explanation_count":4,"code_run_count":5,
			"failure_count":2,"passed_test_count":3,"hint_count":1,"teacher_intervention_count":1,
			"stuck_signal_count":1,"policy_version":"learning-analytics-active-time-v1"
		}}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := statistichttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	summary, err := client.GetLearningSessionSummary(context.Background(), studentID, sessionID)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 1200, summary.ActiveLearningSeconds)
	require.Equal(t, 5, summary.CodeRunCount)
}

func TestClientMapsEmptySummaryToNotFound(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {
		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"summary":null}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()
	client := statistichttp.Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token", HTTPClient: server.Client()}

	_, err := client.GetLearningSessionSummary(context.Background(),
		"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222")
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLearningAnalyticsNotFound)
}
